stemMd: Why might two careful mapmakers draw different boundaries from identical interviews?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They may apply different rules for classifying mixed usage.

options.label: B
options.textMd: One must have interviewed different speakers.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Pronunciation cannot be recorded at all.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The villages must have moved geographically.

explanationMd: The passage explicitly contrasts majority-use and any-use rules. Mixed villages can be classified differently under those rules without any change in the underlying interviews.
